name: Smart Kitchen Assistant
tagline: Snap ingredients or dishes — get recipes, save to Cookbook, build Grocery lists & run Timers.
description: Smart Kitchen Assistant is your all-in-one AI cooking companion. Chat with or without photos: snap the ingredients you have for instant dish ideas, or photograph a finished meal to get the full recipe and step-by-step instructions. Save your favorite recipes to your personal Cookbook with one click, automatically extract ingredients into an interactive Smart Grocery List, and launch live Kitchen Timers directly from cooking steps.
_comment_bundled_executas: Executas that ship inside this app. `anna-app apps publish` publishes each one first, then substitutes its server-minted tool_id into every `bundled:<handle>` reference in manifest.json (in memory - the file on disk is never mutated) and writes bundle/anna-tool-ids.js so the UI bundle can read the same ids.
